summary: In 2000 Dr Yehuda Hiss admitted Abu Kabir pathologists harvested organs in the 1990s from soldiers, citizens, Palestinians and foreign workers. He said 125 removals occurred without family permission; he ran a "museum of skulls", faced investigations and was fired. He said parts were used in cornea transplants; the military said the practice stopped ten years ago, and Israeli officials called Aftonbladet "anti-semitic".
